y-m-50-04.title: Uma umsebenzi oxubile uyi-one-to-one, bobabili imisebenzi bayi-one-to-one?
y-m-50-04.topic: Esingakusho ngo-f no-g uma umsebenzi oxubile g∘f uyi-one-to-one
y-m-50-04.goal: Thola amanani omsebenzi oxubile ngqo kusukela ethebuleni elinikeziwe ukuhlola isitatimende sika-Eunsu, bese uchaza ukuthi ingxenye eyodwa yesitatimende iphulwa kanjani yisibonelo esiphikisayo kuyilapho enye ibamba.
y-m-50-04.material:
Kunamasethi X={1, 2}, Y={a, b, c}, Z={p, q, r}. Imisebenzi f: X→Y no-g: Y→Z imi kanje.
f(1)=a, f(2)=b
g(a)=p, g(b)=q, g(c)=p
Umsebenzi oxubile g∘f unikeza g(f(x)) engxenyeni x ye-X. Umsebenzi i-one-to-one ngumsebenzi lapho izingxenye ezimbili ezihlukile zendawo zihlala zinikezwa amanani ahlukile.
Isitatimende sika-Eunsu: "Uma g∘f ingumsebenzi i-one-to-one, khona-ke bobabili f no-g bayimisebenzi i-one-to-one."
y-m-50-04.thinking.0: Hlukanisa isitatimende sibe izingxenye ezimbili bese uhlulela ngasinye ngokwehlukana
y-m-50-04.prereq.0: 'H1' kulo msebenzi iyilebuli yobunzima kuphela ekwabelweni kokukhiqiza futhi ayisho ukuthi ikharikhulamu ifundisa le miqondo ebangeni elithile. Isisekelo: cabanga ukuthi usuvele uyazi incazelo yomsebenzi, ukuthola inani lomsebenzi oxubile (g∘f)(x)=g(f(x)), nencazelo yomsebenzi i-one-to-one (izingxenye ezimbili ezihlukile zendawo zihlala zihambisana namanani ahlukile). I-one-to-one correspondence nemisebenzi ephambene ayisetshenziswa.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.prompt: Thola amanani ka-g∘f ngqo ku-f no-g abungenhla, bese ukhetha lokho lesi sibonelo sikukhombisayo mayelana nesitatimende sika-Eunsu.

y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.a: Uma g∘f i-one-to-one, g nayo kufanele ibe i-one-to-one
y-m-50-04.s.s1.r.a: Qhathanisa g(a) no-g(c). Hlola ukuthi lo g unalo icala lapho izingxenye ezimbili ezihlukile zinenani elifanayo.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.b: Kulesi sibonelo, g∘f akuyona umsebenzi i-one-to-one
y-m-50-04.s.s1.r.b: Bala g(f(1)) no-g(f(2)) ngqo bese uhlola ukuthi ziyalingana yini. Bheka ukuthi uhlulelile ngaphambi kokubala yini.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.c: Noma g∘f i-one-to-one, g ingase ingabi i-one-to-one
y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.d: c ayivami emanani ka-f, ngakho akukho sidingo sokucabanga g(c) kulesi sibonelo
y-m-50-04.s.s1.r.d: Ukuthi g i-one-to-one kufanele kuhlolwe kuzo zonke izingxenye zendawo Y ka-g. Hlola nokuthi g ithatha inani muni ku-c, engavami emanani ka-f.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.explain: g∘f(1)=g(a)=p no-g∘f(2)=g(b)=q, ngakho g∘f i-one-to-one. Kodwa g(a)=g(c)=p, ngakho g akuyona i-one-to-one. Ngakho ingxenye yesitatimende ethi 'g nayo' iphulwa yilesi sibonelo esisodwa. Isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo singaphula 'njalo'.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.prompt: Kulesi sikhathi, ake sakhe isibonelo esiphikisayo ngqo ngezinombolo. X={1, 2}, Y={1, 2, 3}, Z={1, 2, 3}, futhi f(1)=1, f(2)=2. Nquma amanani g(1)=u, g(2)=v, g(3)=w (ngalinye elilodwa lika-1, 2, 3), bese wenza (u, v, w) amathathu ahlukile lapho g∘f i-one-to-one kodwa g ingeyona i-one-to-one.

y-m-50-03.title: Ukunyakazisa bese ujikijela kuqhathaniswa nokujikijela bese unyakazisa: umphumela uyafana?
y-m-50-03.topic: Ukulandelana kokuhumusha igrafu nokuyiphindaphinda ku-x-axis (umbandela wokuthi imiphumela ifane)
y-m-50-03.goal: Qinisekisa ngesibonelo esiphikisayo ukuthi igrafu ephumayo ingahluka kuye ngokulandelana kwe-translation ne-reflection ku-x-axis, uthole wena amacala lapho ukushintsha ukulandelana kunika igrafu efanayo, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani usebenzisa indawo ye-vertex.
y-m-50-03.material:
Ake sishintshe igrafu ka-y=x² ngokulandelana okubili.
Indlela A: Qala uyiphindaphinde ku-x-axis, bese uyihumusha ngo-p ohlangothini lwe-x no-q ohlangothini lwe-y.
Indlela B: Qala uyihumushe ngo-p ohlangothini lwe-x no-q ohlangothini lwe-y, bese uyiphindaphinda ku-x-axis.
(P eyiphozithivu isho ukunyakaza kwesokudla futhi p enegethivu kwesobunxele, futhi q eyiphozithivu isho ukunyakaza phezulu futhi q enegethivu phansi. Ukuphindaphinda ku-x-axis kusho ukuyijikijela phezulu naphansi.)
UMinho uthi, "Noma ushintsha ukulandelana, igrafu ephumayo ihlala ifana."

Isisekelo: cabanga ukuthi usuvele uyazi igrafu ka-y=x² (i-parabola evuleka phezulu ene-vertex esiqalweni), i-translation ehambisa iphoyinti (x, y) ngo-p ohlangothini lwe-x no-q ohlangothini lwe-y, ne-reflection ku-x-axis ehambisa iphoyinti (x, y) ku-(x, -y).

y-m-50-08.title: Ukusebenza kukaEunji ngenani lokuhlangana: yimuphi umugqa ongalungile?

y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.1: Ngenxa yenani eliphelele, ingxenye eyayingaphansi kwe-x-axis (-1<x<3) igoqiwe phezulu phezu kwe-x-axis. Ingaphezulu lengxenye egoqiwe ngu-(1, 4).

Umcabango: cabanga ukuthi usuvele wazi ukuthi igrafu yomsebenzi we-rational y=k/(x-p)+q (k≠0) inamalayini amabili x=p no-y=q njengama-asymptote, nendlela yokufaka ukuqondanisa kwephoyinti esishweni ukufanisa inani.
